notes: Short unofficial collection of Julia examples (hello world, arrays, dicts, functions, strings, IO, loops/map, types, error handling, DataFrames, plots). Small file (~60k chars) because the repo is small; data files src/iris.csv, src/simple.dat and src/plots.svg were left out (data/binary, not text teaching material). Repo is archived by its author; examples target an older Julia but remain valid introductory patterns.
